'''Priva''' was the smaller of [[Altiria/Anarris]]' two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was the brightest natural satellite in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] night sky.

==History==
Priva was first colonized by the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]] from [[Altiria/Anarris]] around [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]]. The colony, named [[Shalla]] after a goddess of peace worshipped early in Altiri history, was originally a research station and eventually became a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] for receiving offworld visitors.
